description:
Tall and gracefully proportioned, the Mackenzie Chest offers substantial storage in a vertical footprint that's perfect for nurseries where floor space is precious. Dovetailed drawers with smooth full-extension glides keep clothing and accessories neatly organized and easy to reach.

Solid Brown Maple construction ensures lasting beauty and durability. Coordinates with the full Mackenzie collection.
